diagnostics.message: The EMR on EKS virtual cluster (aws_emrcontainers_virtual_cluster.emr) is registered against the EKS cluster, but it only receives the cluster *name* via var.container_providers (built from module.eks.cluster.name). This does not guarantee the EKS cluster and its access configuration are ready before the virtual cluster is created: the project's own comment documents that the EKS aws-auth ConfigMap must first be updated with the AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEMRContainers role mapping (done manually via the eksctl command exposed by the enable_emr_access output). The virtual cluster should be ordered after :module.eks (cluster + access setup) is complete; add an explicit depends_on = [module.eks] on the emr module/resource to close this operational gap.
